description: Safe, synthetic Urdu writing-assistant benchmark. The runner expands 15 passages across 8 actions for 120 cases.

actions.label: Fix Urdu
actions.instruction: Fix grammar, spelling and punctuation only. Preserve the original meaning and do not add facts.
actions.expectedEffect: Correct errors while staying close to the source wording.

actions.label: Improve
actions.instruction: Make the Urdu clearer and more natural while preserving the original meaning and facts.
actions.expectedEffect: Improve flow and clarity without changing intent.

actions.label: Make simpler
actions.instruction: Rewrite in easy everyday Urdu. Preserve the meaning, names, numbers, dates and concrete facts.
actions.expectedEffect: Use simpler vocabulary and sentence structure without losing information.

actions.label: Formal
actions.instruction: Rewrite in respectful professional Urdu. Preserve all facts and do not invent titles, relationships or commitments.
actions.expectedEffect: Increase formality and respectfulness without changing substance.

actions.label: Friendly
actions.instruction: Rewrite in warm, natural and friendly Urdu. Preserve all facts and avoid exaggerated praise or promises.
actions.expectedEffect: Make the tone conversational and friendly without changing substance.

actions.label: Shorten
actions.instruction: Make the text noticeably shorter while preserving the main meaning and all important facts.
actions.expectedEffect: Reduce length without dropping critical information.

actions.label: Expand
actions.instruction: Make the text clearer with a little more detail, but do not invent any new facts, reasons, dates, people or commitments.
actions.expectedEffect: Add explanatory wording only from information already present.

actions.label: Summarize
actions.instruction: Give a concise Urdu summary containing the main point and important facts only. Do not add new information.
actions.expectedEffect: Produce a compact summary with high factual fidelity.
